collection.title: Talbot Express 1982 to 1994 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Talbot Express 1982 - 1994 requires a 20" wiper blade the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
